entries.title: Proverbs 17:1
segments: Better [is] a dry piece of bread, and quietness with it, than a house full of sacrifices [with] fighting.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:2
segments: A wise servant shall have rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brothers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:3
segments: The refining pot [is] for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tries the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:4
segments: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips; a liar gives ear to an evil tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:5
segments: Whoever scorns the poor reviles his Maker; he who is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:6
segments: Sons of sons [are] the crown of old men, and the glory of sons [are] their fathers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:7
segments: An excellent lip [is] not fitting for a fool; much less are lying lips fitting for a prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:8
segments: A bribe [is] like a precious stone in the eyes of him who has it; wherever he turns, he is prudent.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:9
segments: He who covers a transgression seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:10
segments: A reproof enters more into a wise man than a thousand stripes into a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:11
segments: An evil one seeks only rebellion; so a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:12
segments: Let a bear robbed [of her cubs] meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:13
segments: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:14
segments: The beginning of strife [is like] letting out water; therefore leave off fighting, before it breaks out.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:15
segments: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the just, even both of them [are] hateful to the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:16
segments: Why [is there] a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, since [he has] no heart [for it]?

entries.title: Proverbs 17:17
segments: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for the time of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:18
segments: A man lacking heart strikes hands; he pledges in the presence of his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:19
segments: He who loves fighting loves transgression; he who makes his gate high seeks ruin.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:20
segments: He who has a perverse heart finds no good, and he who [has] a crooked tongue falls into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:21
segments: He who fathers a fool [does it] to his sorrow; the father of a fool has no joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:22
segments: A merry heart does good [like] a medicine, but a broken spirit dries the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:23
segments: A wicked [man] takes a bribe out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:24
segments: Wisdom [is] before him who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool [are] in the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:25
segments: A foolish son [is] a grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:26
segments: And [it is] not good to punish the just, nor to strike princes for uprightness.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:27
segments: He who has knowledge uses few words; a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:28
segments: Even a fool, when he [is] silent, is counted wise, and he who shuts his lips [is counted as] a man of understanding.
